findings.note: The mutation capture reports a restored resolver SHA-256 of 457b21559a6fbc02abdae0bf1c9bd1c4f672c1637ade4f3ad424f5fb9c329894, while the captured current MANIFEST.sha256 row and implementation-report Outputs declaration both identify the shipped resolver as eac8f1d6cc410208e5929c61d8f58c6bd55f48494696c5dceaa6f97194f00287. This makes the repeated claim that the mutations ran against and restored the exact shipped bytes unverifiable. The captured implementation and current 395/0 focused test evidence otherwise support the acceptance criteria, so this is evidence-freshness drift rather than a demonstrated transactional correctness defect.
